findings.headline: Trust Services Criteria CC1–CC8 conformant across the observation period with zero exceptions
findings.rationale: Every privileged decision over the 91-day window emitted a §0.3 envelope to the per-tenant hash-linked audit chain (12,847 events). Every event verified offline via the published assembler_kid pubkey. WORM triggers blocked all 0 attempted mutations on the audit_chain_entries, decisions, risk_assessments, and data_classification_assignments tables.

findings.headline: Logical-access controls (CC6.1, CC6.2, CC6.3) attested by entitlement-gate enforcement on every public-perimeter route
findings.rationale: Static-graph CI gate proves all 52 HTTP-perimeter workers invoke requireEntitlement(); zero ungated routes for the observation period. Invoice-paid hard gate enforced on every privileged operation.

findings.headline: Change-management (CC8.1) attested by signed manifest publication + Replay-Proof per release
findings.rationale: Every release to public/main carried a signed Compiled Authority Bundle whose Replay-Proof was re-derived by the conformance runner from the public-key registry alone.
